preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 1000.
The total number of cells n * m must not exceed 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i][j] <= n * m for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All f_{i,j} must be distinct integers between 1 and n * m.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of pleasant segments of silence as a string.
